channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Judge grants Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss a preliminary injunction for extra eligibility
item.description: Ole Miss Quarterback, Trinidad Chambliss has been granted a sixth year of eligibility by Mississippi Judge.

item.title: What The Tech: What is the safest way to connect to a hotspot?
item.description: Instead of connecting your laptop to public WiFi, you can use your phone’s cellular connection through a wired connection.

item.title: Mostly sunny Friday, clouds increase Saturday, rain/storms Sunday
item.description: Temperatures warm to near 70° Friday afternoon, while the sky remains mostly sunny. Friday night still turns somewhat cool, with lows in the 40s while the sky becomes partly cloudy.

item.title: Camden woman indicted in $220,000 theft scheme
item.description: A Camden woman has been indicted on three felony charges related to a $220,000 theft and identity theft scheme.

item.title: Reaction to officer-involved shooting in Dannelly Pines neighborhood in Montgomery
item.description: The quiet Dannelly Pines neighborhood of Montgomery was the scene of an officer-involved shooting between a suspect and an ALEA agent this week.

item.title: Former Vice President Kamala Harris speaks in Montgomery
item.description: Former Vice President Kamala Harris made a stop in Montgomery to speak about her political career, her book and her whirlwind run for the White House in 2024.

item.title: What’s Happening: February 13-15
item.description: There's plenty to do in the River Region this weekend as we celebrate both Mardi Gras and Valentine's Day!

item.title: Man convicted of attempted murder in Montgomery
item.description: A man has been convicted of attempted murder after a shooting at a Montgomery convenience store.

item.title: ‘You’re Not in This Alone’: Statewide Organizations Collaborate to Better Serve Victims of Violent Crime
item.description: The Alabama Crime Victims Compensation Commission hosted the summit to establish a statewide network to help victims of violent crime.

item.title: Rain And T-storms Likely Sunday
item.description: A line of storms will be capable of producing damaging winds early Sunday.
